verdict.rationale: Pandoc documents that it ships an official Haskell library alongside the CLI, so developers can build against it programmatically. Lua custom readers, writers and filters provide a further first-party extension API. The evidence is a single thin mention, though, with no breadth of language SDKs or SDK documentation shown. missing for 10: official SDKs beyond Haskell (e.g. Python/JS), documented SDK API reference and examples, independent corroboration of building against the library.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Pandoc includes a Haskell library and a standalone command-line program.
custom readers and writers can be written in Lua
